The SDK's checksum behavior, not the protocol: since 2.30.0 the shared HttpChecksumStage computes a CRC32 flexible checksum (x-amz-checksum-crc32) for an @httpChecksumRequired operation, and sends Content-MD5 only when no checksum algorithm resolves (HttpChecksumUtils.isMd5ChecksumRequired). The case expects Content-MD5. The legacy path fails it the same way; the request line, headers and body the protocol writes match the case
